load_midas_depth_model: load a midas depth estimation model from a weight file for inference on a torch device
load_dpt_beit_model: load a DPT BEiT large depth model with 512x512 resolution from a checkpoint file
load_dpt_swin_model: load a DPT Swin Transformer depth model with 384x384 resolution from a checkpoint file
load_midas_v21_small: load the midas v2.1 small efficientnet lite3 depth model for 256x256 inference
load_openvino_midas_model: load an openvino optimized midas small depth model from an XML model file
